description: Create an English repository-local AGENTS guide, focused persona catalog (commander, protocol engineer, agent-integration engineer, security reviewer, interoperability reviewer, quality engineer), delivery/domain rules, and an Issue-to-merge workflow blueprint. The primary lifecycle is GitHub Issue -> CarryCtx task/team/scope -> branch/worktree -> commits -> PR -> independent review plus CI -> merge -> task/issue closure. Preserve the unborn-repository shared-checkout exception, require bitty-docs synchronization for public behavior, and do not add product code or commit/push.
title: Initialize repository personas and delivery workflow

description: Create a concise English README for the unborn bitty-mcp repository. Use only canonical HTTPS links, never local relative or absolute filesystem Markdown links. State adapter ownership, pre-implementation status, canonical bitty-docs authority, read-only and capability boundaries, and that no MCP transport, tool, installation, release, or compatibility claim exists. Add no code, dependency, command, CI, commit, push, or remote mutation.
title: Add the pre-implementation repository overview

description: Publish the reviewed repository foundation as the initial main-branch snapshot. This is the documented unborn-repository bootstrap exception: no branch, worktree, pull request, or GitHub Issue can precede the first commit. Audit the exact untracked file set and ignored files; run CI-equivalent local checks; independently review scope, generated artifacts, local databases, credentials, secret values, and accidental product implementation. After independent acceptance, create one coherent initial commit directly on main and push it to the canonical origin with upstream tracking. Verify the remote branch SHA and GitHub default branch, then monitor automatically triggered CI when configured. Do not force-push, create tags or releases, invoke deployment, read secret values, or make content changes outside a separately authorized task.
title: Publish the initial MCP snapshot

description:
## Mission
Add repository governance and toolchain scaffolding files to THIS repository, mirroring the structure and spirit of the reference repository `***REDACTED-PATH***`.

## Files to add (brand-new only)
- LICENSE - MIT license text mirroring the reference repo, holder line adapted to the Bitty project ("Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitty Terminal Contributors" style - match the exact phrasing style used by the reference LICENSE).
- CONTRIBUTING.md - adapt the reference: development setup, Conventional Commits expectation, delivery lifecycle Issue -> Branch -> Commit -> PR -> Review -> Merge, pointer to AGENTS.md and justfile quality gates.
- SECURITY.md - supported versions section marked unreleased, private vulnerability reporting via GitHub Security Advisories, disclosure policy and response expectations.
- CHANGELOG.md - Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 format with only an "## [Unreleased]" section.
- commitlint.config.ts - mirror the reference conventional-commits configuration.
- .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc - mirror the reference markdownlint-cli2 configuration (ignore globs for node_modules, target, dist, build, site).## Hard constraints
- First inspect the repo with `ls -la`: SKIP any matrix file that already exists and record that fact instead of overwriting.
- DO NOT modify ANY existing file (no AGENTS.md, README.md, justfile, package.json, wrangler.jsonc edits). Tooling wiring proposals (lefthook, just targets, CI workflows) go into a progress note as recommendations for a follow-up post-initialization task.
- No commits, no pushes, no remote/git state changes. Git write operations are NOT authorized for this task.
- If main becomes born mid-task (another agent pushed the initial snapshot), stop adding files immediately, record what is complete, review + hand off.
- English-only content. Describe files as proposed scaffolding, never as implemented product behavior.
- The reference repo is READ-ONLY evidence: do not execute, build, install, or copy anything from it beyond adapting the listed governance files.

## Verification
- Every matrix file either present or explicitly skipped-because-exists.
- Links inside CONTRIBUTING.md/SECURITY.md resolve within this repository.
- CHANGELOG follows Keep a Changelog headings; commitlint.config.ts is syntactically plausible TypeScript (visual check only, no installs).
- One progress note per nontrivial decision; list final added/skipped set in the last note.

## Closure
- Progress notes -> checkpoint -> `task review` (stop at IN_REVIEW; NEVER complete the task yourself).
- Handoff HO addressed to commander `opencode` summarizing added files, skipped files, and wiring recommendations.
title: Add governance and toolchain scaffolding files

description:
## Mission

## Scope

- Minimal read-only CI workflow running those gates on PRs.
- .gitignore addition for .worktrees/ if absent.

## Constraints
- Do not change product source files. Follow AGENTS.md and .carryctx rules. Implementer stops at IN_REVIEW.
- Record every version pin introduced. No direct pushes to main.
title: Wire scaffolding tooling into enforceable quality gates

description:
Port bitty CTX-0316 (merged PR #535, merge 8fae335) workflow-import restore helper into bitty-mcp so fresh clones can restore this repository's own CarryCtx DB from the bitty-mcp-workflow mirror LATEST snapshot.

Deliverables:
- scripts/fetch-ctxpack.sh: staging-clone bitty-mcp-workflow (default URL, env/flag overridable), read LATEST (or --snapshot), stage the snapshot, validate it via scripts/publish-ctxpack-selftest.sh --no-round-trip before any local DB write, preserve the committed .carryctx/config.toml across carryctx init, import with `carryctx import --mode replace`, then print provenance (snapshot id + source commit) and `carryctx stats`. Refuses to replace a non-empty local DB without --force; --dry-run fetches + validates only; timeout on every git/carryctx/python op.
- scripts/fetch-ctxpack-selftest.sh: isolated temp HOME/XDG/TMPDIR lab with throwaway targets; 6 cases (empty-DB import, non-empty refusal, --force replacement, dry-run no-write, tampered-snapshot refusal, empty-DB init).
- justfile: workflow-import / workflow-import-dry.
- README + AGENTS restore notes; mirror README restore-recipe text in scripts/publish-ctxpack.sh (documentation text only; no publish pipeline behavior change).

Evidence: selftest 6/6 PASS in an isolated temp HOME; just check green; real E2E restore of the bitty-mcp-workflow LATEST snapshot into a throwaway clone with carryctx stats counts matching manifest.json; PR CI green.

Repo: bitty-mcp. Branch ctx-0014/feat-workflow-import. Source: bitty origin/main 8fae335 scripts/fetch-ctxpack*.sh + justfile/docs. Authorized lifecycle: commit, push, PR, squash merge, issue close.

Priority: P1 | Area: devtools | Labels: feat,area:devtools,P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0

description:
CarryCtx's prepare-commit-msg hook prepends `[CTX-XXXX] ` to commits, but @commitlint/config-conventional rejects the resulting header, forcing --no-verify. Apply the canonical merged fix (bitty-plugin-template 84241b0, bitty-plugin-sdk 12d8a4a): add parserPreset.parserOpts.headerPattern /^(?:\[CTX-\d+\]\s+)?(\w*)(?:\((.*)\))?!?: (.*)$/ with headerCorrespondence [type,scope,subject] to commitlint.config.ts.

Acceptance:
- [CTX-XXXX] chore: x accepted; chore x rejected; foo: x rejected; [CTX-XXXX] foo: x rejected (type-enum preserved).
- just check green; conventional enforcement not weakened.
- Commit created with hooks active (no --no-verify).
- Issue + PR with required metadata; CI green; independent reviewer APPROVE; squash merge; publish ctxpack to bitty-mcp-workflow and verify LATEST.
title: fix(dev-tooling): commitlint must accept carryctx [CTX-XXXX] prefix

description:
Port the merged in-repo CarryCtx publication model from bitty (bbad681, CTX-0319) to bitty-mcp, retiring the bitty-mcp-workflow mirror usage.

Native flow: `carryctx export --publication` redacts every table row + project.json, stamps manifest.redacted, and commits one snapshot to refs/heads/carryctx-snapshots; the target pushes that ref only when it advanced. Import uses fetch + native `carryctx import --from-git origin/carryctx-snapshots`.

Scope:
- scripts/workflow-publish.sh (new, ported from bitty)
- scripts/workflow-import.sh (new, ported from bitty)
- .github/workflows/snapshot-source.yml (new staleness gate)
- justfile workflow targets -> new scripts
- README.md "Workflow mirror restore" -> in-repo snapshot refresh
- AGENTS.md fresh-clone restore wording
- delete scripts/publish-ctxpack*.sh, publish-ctxpack-redact.py, fetch-ctxpack*.sh
- publish refs/heads/carryctx-snapshots post-merge and verify no host paths

No Python; no unrelated changes.
title: chore(workflow): publish CarryCtx snapshots in-repo (retire mirror)
